description: Land Acquisition - Order to acquire the lands in Gangoda, Kurunegala District ; Wadamarachchi, Jaffna District and Pannala, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It specifically approves the acquisition of servitude over multiple land parcels described in detail (including lot numbers, land names, extents, boundaries, and claimants) for the purpose of laying sewerage pipelines. The content focuses on property rights and land use for infrastructure development, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
